card.name: Partway through sulfa and metronidazole names
card.fires_on: The pole responds partway through drug names such as sulfamethoxazole, metronidazole and sodium metabisulfite, on the piece right after the first syllables. It also fires on spaces after dosing-table entries and on 'in' after 'bound to the protein'.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long drug names that start with sulfam-, met- or sodium met-.

modes.label: Blank gap in dosing tables
modes.description: A space after a condition or dose in an antibiotic dosing table.

modes.label: Nutrition sentence
modes.description: The word 'in' after 'bound to the protein' in a vitamin B12 passage.
modes.example: Vitamin B12 is bound to the protein<< in>> food.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long drug names like sulfamethoxazole and metronidazole, and on gaps in antibiotic dosing tables.
